reviewBoundary: Each item contains only bounded history, a bounded delta, a candidate continuation and source summaries. The reviewer decides wording quality; deterministic identity and evidence gates remain authoritative.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The latest history window contains one settled story and one thread with stable identifiers.

newDelta.summary: The refresh contains no new source event and no changed source fingerprint.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate keeps the same story, thread and chapter references and reports an unchanged window.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Bounded prior window and stable semantic identifiers.
Empty delta with matching source fingerprint.

unknowns: Whether an external source changed outside this bounded window.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: A story records one outcome in an established thread and chapter.

newDelta.summary: One new engineering event extends the same outcome and cites a new bounded evidence item.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate appends the new event to the existing story while retaining its thread and chapter references.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior story wording and its last event.
One bounded event describing a compatible follow-up outcome.

unknowns: The full repository outside the supplied window.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The thread groups an earlier story about the same durable product direction.

newDelta.summary: A later outcome is related at thread level but has a distinct subject and event lineage.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate creates a new story under the existing thread and leaves the earlier story intact.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Earlier story and thread relationship.
Process evidence describing the later direction.
Engineering evidence for a separate later outcome.

unknowns: Whether the two outcomes share a future implementation boundary.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The prior window contains a story about one product subject.

newDelta.summary: The new event concerns a different subject and has no shared evidence with the prior story.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate presents a separate story and thread, with no attachment to the prior subject.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior subject and its bounded evidence.
New event with a distinct subject and evidence lineage.

conflicts: The chapter is shared even though the stories are unrelated at thread level.
unknowns: Whether a later chapter boundary will be needed.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The latest chapter contains a coherent sequence of two related stories.

newDelta.summary: Two new events arrive together: one follows the chapter subject and one introduces a different outcome.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate extends the coherent tail and places the heterogeneous outcome at a separate chapter boundary.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior chapter sequence and related subject.
Coherent follow-up event.
Heterogeneous event with a different outcome.

conflicts: The two new events share a refresh boundary but not an outcome subject.
unknowns: The final chapter title is still a bounded semantic label.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: A user presentation correction labels an existing story while retaining its source lineage.

newDelta.summary: A new event adds evidence to the same story without changing the corrected subject.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate retains the user label, appends the new event and keeps the original correction reference.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Corrected story wording and original event lineage.
Additive event compatible with the corrected subject.

unknowns: Whether a later event will make the presentation label obsolete.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: A presentation correction points to a story whose source lineage was present in the prior window.

newDelta.summary: The source lineage was rewritten; the old target is absent from the new bounded source set.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate leaves the old correction unresolved and surfaces a conflict instead of attaching it to another story.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior correction target and its source lineage.
Bounded rewrite evidence showing the old lineage is unavailable.

conflicts: The correction target cannot be safely matched to the rewritten lineage.
unknowns: Which later story, if any, a reviewer may choose to relabel.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The prior state summary and agent context both refer to the same last observed project revision.

newDelta.summary: A bounded source change advances the project revision and supplies a matching agent context update.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate presents the new state and context at one revision while retaining the preceding history references.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior state revision and history references.
Engineering delta for the new revision.
Agent context tied to the same bounded revision.

unknowns: Changes after state-081 that are outside this package.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The prior story contains process evidence from an agent result and labels its engineering status as limited.

newDelta.summary: Later Git evidence clarifies which part of the agent description is supported by an engineering change.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate preserves the process source, adds the engineering source and keeps unsupported interpretation qualified.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior story with process-source provenance.
A bounded description of work intent and observed context.
Later engineering evidence that narrows the supported outcome.

conflicts: Process wording is broader than the later engineering evidence.
unknowns: Whether the remaining process description was completed outside the supplied Git evidence.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The project history is built from bounded document evidence and has no Git source.

newDelta.summary: A document fingerprint and bounded content sample changed while the project remained non-code.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate continues the document story, states that Git history is unavailable and avoids code-specific claims.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior document identity, bounded sample and no-Git limitation.
New document fingerprint and content signals.

unknowns: Binary or unreadable portions outside the sampled document content.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The prior window contains a completed story and a persisted checkpoint for the next bounded window.

newDelta.summary: A new event is available; the first semantic request is unavailable and the checkpoint can be resumed later.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate preserves completed history, marks the affected interpretation as limited and leaves a resumable checkpoint.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Completed prior window and checkpoint identity.
New event with bounded source evidence and limited interpretation availability.

conflicts: The candidate cannot provide a full semantic continuation while the provider is unavailable.
unknowns: The wording that a later resumed request may produce.

oldBoundedHistory.summary: The prior project projection contains a managed overview and a managed capability note with stable entity metadata.

newDelta.summary: One source entity is unchanged and one affected entity has a new bounded history reference.

candidateContinuation.summary: The candidate keeps the unchanged projection entity and updates only the affected managed entity while retaining its stable identity.

evidenceSummaries.summary: Prior managed entity identities and bounded content ownership.
Affected entity metadata and the new history reference.

conflicts: Projection content is a view of the supplied history and is not an additional fact source.
unknowns: User-authored content outside the managed blocks.
